observation.command: cd /workspace && for u in /en/calendar /en/categories /en/community /en/welcome /en/magazine/hello-world /en/events /en/locations; do code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/p.html -w "%{http_code}" "http://openculturas.ddev.site$u"); t=$(grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/p.html | head -1); echo "$u -> $code $t"; done; echo "=== check for PHP errors on pages ==="; for u in /en /en/calendar /en/events; do curl -s "http://openculturas.ddev.site$u" | grep -ci "fatal error\|exception\|Error:" ; done
